verdict.rationale: Gusto's press release says its intelligent payroll automations "flag anomalies, anything unusual" and turn payroll into a review and sign-off step. That is AI-driven anomaly flagging for review, but it appears only as a single press-release line and is scoped to payroll runs. The agent-prepared prioritized decision list adds some support for routing items to review. missing for 10: out-of-policy or policy-rule flagging (e.g., reimbursements or expenses beyond policy), anomaly detection beyond payroll transactions, detailed docs on what is detected and how, independent or hands-on corroboration.
